question: How many subscribers will Russell Brand's YouTube channel show on 27 November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Display dropped 6.61M->6.6M around Nov 11-12, so underlying was ~6,609k then. Trackers: vidIQ -10K/7d, -20K/28d, -10K in October; youtubers.me -2.6K/7d. Post-sentencing unsubscribe wave likely decays, but channel still active (Nov 15 Sunday Service with prison statement) causing controversy plus possible supporter inflow. At -300 to -1500/day over ~16 days, underlying lands ~6,586k-6,605k: roughly 48% 6.59M, 40% 6.60M, 7% <=6.58M, 5% >=6.61M. Termination resolves to last Social Blade count (~same). No human market found on Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmakers.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: notch crossed ~Nov 11, -10K/7d and -20K/28d per vidIQ/Trendreport, October -10K, Nov 15 upload, no market. The only factual nuance is the exact crossing date (Nov 10-12), which I could not settle without web access; it shifts the implied underlying by a few K and is carried as uncertainty. The remaining dispute is judgment: whether the post-sentencing loss rate (~1,100/day) persists or reverts toward baseline (~400/day) given new uploads. Required ~600/day sits between them; I lean slightly toward 6.59M because Nov 15 controversy and termination pressure keep news attention negative, consistent with the runs' medians.
